body:
**What changed**
- **Show only enabled or disabled mods:** buttons above the list choose All, Enabled or Disabled, each with its count. Enabled hides the disabled mods. The choice works together with a tag and the search, and stays after a restart.
- **Sort by every column:** a click on Status, Type or Integrity now sorts the list too, as Mod and Installed do. A second click reverses the order: enabled mods first, types by name, problems first.
- **Tag suggestions:** under the Tags field, your own tags show first, then common ones such as Quality of life. They narrow as you type, Tab completes the tag, and a click adds one.

**Install:** unzip `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_1.5.9.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
